subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: Should maintainers adopt the open conflicting fork PR, replace it with a fresh narrow schema-only repair, or close that PR and keep this issue waiting?
rationale: The bug shape is clear, but an open non-maintainer fork PR already claims the exact fix with closing syntax while being conflicting and not maintainer-editable, so automation should not create a competing repair until maintainers choose how to handle that candidate.

options.title: Replace with a clean narrow repair

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork
options.body: Manually rebase the fork branch, drop stale unrelated changes, and require current proof before merging it.

options.title: Keep waiting on the fork
options.body: Leave this issue paired with the open fork PR, accepting that the documented config key remains broken meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Replace with a clean narrow repair
